name: Twins
overview: The Scriptures reveal the phenomenon of twins as part of God's sovereign design, highlighting their unique beginnings and roles within His redemptive plan. The birth of twins is marked by struggle and significance, as seen when Rebekah felt her children struggling within her and sought the LORD's guidance, resulting in the birth of Esau and Jacob, with Jacob grasping Esau's heel at birth. Similarly, the account of twins in Tamar's womb underscores the continuation of God's covenant promises through generations. These narratives emphasize God's providence and purpose even in the earliest moments of life.
